purpose: Public source provenance for point-in-building analysis; not proof of store location, tenancy, operating status or surveyed height.
coordinatePolicy: All27607 published source store coordinates remain unchanged.

license.sharingRequirement: Make the agreement text available with shared data.

coverage.physicalBuildingCompleteness: Not asserted; all official country partitions were processed, but imagery gaps and ML omissions may remain.

method.join: unchanged source point tested against unmodified Microsoft ML Polygon/MultiPolygon footprints including holes
method.point_inside: exactly one containing raw footprint has boundary clearance>=10m
method.boundary_candidate: containing footprints exist but no candidate clears the10m guard
method.ambiguous: more than one containing raw footprint clears the10m guard
method.no_building: no containing footprint in the fully processed Microsoft Thailand release; does not establish no physical building exists
method.unavailable: not emitted after complete country source processing
method.identity: msml-20260813 plus first20hex of full canonical source geometry SHA256; exact duplicate geometry coalesced with every source observation preserved
method.confidence: no confidence threshold applied; valid0..1 is footprint detection confidence only; missing/-1 is unknown
method.tenancy: neither geometry containment nor ML confidence confirms a store, venue, floor or tenant
method.heights: Positive source height is a model estimate. Missing/-1/nonpositive/invalid source height is unknown; any 3m extrusion is display-only.

height.note: Every retained candidate in this snapshot has raw height=-1 and no usable source height. The3m extrusion is display-only, never a measured or inferred floor/height fact.

confidence.note: Valid0..1 denotes footprint detection confidence only. Legacy -1/missing is unknown; neither denotes the probability that a store occupies a building.

microsoft.vintage: The release/index date does not identify per-building imagery vintage.

reproduction.workDirectory: Explicit directory outside the public repository; raw source cache is not published.
reproduction.cacheOnlyCliResume: PASS: all142 partitions validated using existing source and candidate checksums.
reproduction.providerExportReproduction: PASS: all27607 per-store results and every raw geometry/source property reproduced exactly in a separate external work directory.

citymeterNative.attribution: CityMETER V4; ©OpenStreetMap contributors;3D-GloBFP (Che et al.);Google Open Buildings
citymeterNative.geometryNote: Source affine EPSG4326 tile-bounds transform, not standard Mercator display interpolation; original Grocery plotted coordinates unchanged.
citymeterNative.heightNote: V4 tile heights mix modeled3D-GloBFP, imputed Open Buildings and OSM context; tile fields do not identify the per-feature upstream source. No measured-height or floor claim.

venueReferences.method: Exact accepted venue source ID crosswalk; no nearest-building replacement.
limitations: Venue geometry follows a name crosswalk, independently of point-in-building results.
No store coordinate is changed; neither name nor containment proves tenancy, floor or operating status.
Height is source/model context. Unknown display fallback is not a measured height.
Only original footprint/part geometry is reused; unrelated source outlet IDs are omitted.

retailRefresh.pointSource: Big C official public contact directory
retailRefresh.coverage: Two complete pinned Microsoft partitions reused offline; native/building references not queried for the new points. Existing27607 source decisions unchanged.
